title: The work in photos alongside the invoice
description: The shots chosen and their captions explain what was done on the job.

blocks.text: A short line on the document is sometimes not enough to match the work against the result that was discussed.

quote.text: Each time I send a receipt or quote with the individual pictures of the items, customers feel more satisfied and confident with what they are buying or requesting.

blocks.text: Add photos to particular line items, choose the order and the captions. Check the final file together with the attachments before sending.
The photos have to belong to the right job; a set of images doesn’t replace a clear description of the agreed scope.
